description: ONNX export of the validated H-TB student (the whole student file recorded in provenance). This manifest records what these bytes ARE and where they came from. It deliberately records nothing about how they perform or whether they are in use, because those change without these bytes changing.
model_id_note: sha256(graph_sha256 + ':' + external_data_sha256), first 16 hex. Addresses the PAIR.

provenance.exporter_config: scripts/GPU/alphazero/export_onnx.py unmodified (byte-identical to the August export commit 32751284); MLX_ENABLE_TF32=0 .venv/bin/python -m scripts.GPU.alphazero.export_onnx --weights /Users/bill/twixt-cache/htb-pilot/student.safetensors --output <scratch>/model.onnx; hidden=128, blocks=6 (defaults), in_channels=NUM_CHANNELS=30, max_moves=576, opset_version=18, dynamic_axes=None, do_constant_folding at the torch.onnx.export default (true), so BatchNorm is folded into the convolutions -- August's invocation for calib020_0001 with only the weights path changed
provenance.runtime_versions: python 3.14.10; mlx 0.30.3; mlx-metal 0.30.3; torch 2.10.0; onnx 1.20.1; onnxruntime 1.24.4 (python); numpy 2.4.1; node v24.22.0; onnxruntime-node 1.23.2; exported on darwin arm64. Differs from calib020_0001's export in python (3.14.6 then) and node (v26.7.0 then).

provenance_note: Every provenance field is known and recorded. The student's sha256 was verified equal to 0e1cb621... immediately before and after the export, and the working tree carried no modified tracked files at that moment. Exported once, to scratch, then placed here by content address; no alternate export was produced. The source file lives outside the repository (~/twixt-cache/htb-pilot/), as in the H-TB confirmation run (ledger, Post-closure entry 54).
contract_note: Transcribed from onnxruntime-node session metadata for this artifact and enforced at load time against the manifest, its own internal consistency, and the fixed application contract derived from gameLogic NUM_CHANNELS and BOARD_SIZE plus AlphaZeroInference.maxMoves.
claims: Identity and provenance only. This manifest asserts that model.onnx and model.onnx.data are the bytes described by graph, external_data and contract, and that they were exported from the checkpoint recorded in provenance. It makes NO parity, strength, serving-status or deployment-status claim of its own. The separately reviewed records own those conclusions: the H-TB integration proposal, docs/superpowers/2026-11-06-htb-integration-proposal.md, and its ledger entries.
